entries.subject: Placement
entries.finding: Gaia DR3 source 2106630885454013184: position at J2016.0. Distance: McDonald, Zijlstra & Watson (2017), MNRAS 471, 770, table 2, HIP 92862: distance 91.408 pc, the paper's parallax inverted (Gaia DR1's where it revised the star's, else the Hipparcos reduction of van Leeuwen 2007; section 2.3; fractional uncertainty 0.011), at which the luminosity and radius hold (https://doi.org/10.1093/mnras/stx1433): 91.408 +/- 1.005 pc; Gaia DR3 parallax 10.4404 +/- 0.2636 mas (same row, RUWE 2.95), 39.6 standard errors, is not used. Proper motion: Gaia DR3 (same row): 20.136, 81.349 mas/yr. Radial velocity from SIMBAD's radial velocity for Gaia DR3 2106630885454013184 (quality A), from 2009A&A...498..627F; Gaia DR3 measures none.

entries.subject: Radius, mass and temperature
entries.finding: Radius 144.458 solar radii from McDonald, Zijlstra & Watson (2017), MNRAS 471, 770, table 2, HIP 92862: radius 144.458 solar radii, implied by the fitted luminosity 2398.17 solar luminosities (fractional uncertainty 0.075) and temperature (https://doi.org/10.1093/mnras/stx1433). No mass is measured, so GM is 0, the records' unpublished value. Temperature 3363 +/- 125 K from McDonald, Zijlstra & Watson (2017), MNRAS 471, 770, table 2, HIP 92862: effective temperature 3363 +/- 125 K, from the fit of a model atmosphere to the star's spectral energy distribution (goodness of fit Q 0.074).
